verdicts.reason: All rules hold: a program checks the counts (A1), assisted matches the brief's 'assisted to reliable' (A2), the check covers headers first, open only rule-marked, a why line and zero replies (A3), 0/0 is valid (A4), and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).

A3 fails: the done-when only greps the quoted ask in the thread and never checks the brief's 'stop before send' (for example, zero send/reply/forward calls in the log), so a draft that was also sent would still exit 0.

All rules hold: the program computes strict overlaps from calendar times and prints a count (A1), assisted matches the brief (A2), it names both events and excludes back-to-back meetings (A3), 0/0 and unread are valid (A4), and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).

All rules hold: unique source ids plus a verbatim quote with a locator are program checks (A1), assisted matches the brief (A2), the check enforces one item per source, an attached source and no item from memory (A3), an empty agenda is valid (A4), and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).

A3 fails: 'stop' is enforced only by comparing calendar snapshots before and after, so a travel or reservation booking submitted outside the calendar (a form, Zapier, a browser) still passes, even though the done-when claims 'no booking made'.

All rules hold: the jq -e schema check and the action-log verb scan are program checks (A1), gated matches 'Stop. Always gated.' (A2), the check enforces both prepare-details and stop (A3), and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).
